composer: Configure Tools... opens Copilot's built-in tool set ('13 Selected', 'applied globally for all chat sessions that use the default agent') - OMP owns execution, so nothing there reaches the harness
composer: the Permission picker offers Default permissions / Allow all / Autopilot (Preview) - Copilot permission semantics, while Caret's approvals and questions come from OMP (plan section 4)
composer: the Agent mode picker opens Agent / Configure Custom Agents...; whether modes change OMP behaviour is unverified and Configure Custom Agents has no surface here

composer: Dictate (Speech to Text) is unverified; message-row actions (Restore checkpoint, Fork conversation, Helpful/Unhelpful) depend on agent-host and feedback services the fork does not wire and are likely inert
audit.conclusion: the composer picks (tools, permission mode, custom agents) are the same class of problem as the removed icon: base Copilot concepts rendered over a harness that does not implement them. Each needs a decision - wire to OMP, hide, or disable with a reason (plan section 5) - before the composer can be called parity-clean
